title: Dismast
summary: DISMAST, verb transitive [dis and mast.] To deprive of a mast or masts; to break and carry away the masts from; as, a storm dismated the ship.

inlines.v: DISMAST, verb transitive [dis and mast.] To deprive of a mast or masts; to break and carry away the masts from; as, a storm dismated the ship.
